analysis: The PR changes docs/architecture/inference.md only: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and one new table row (head line 1387) documenting `demandedLatestCheckpointMinimumTokens`, a paged complete-store effective-token floor for dense Qwen3.5/3.8. No executable code, config, or security control is modified. The supplied base excerpts (lines 1612-2427) are unchanged surrounding documentation covering MTP, sampling, JSON-answer constraints, tool parsers, vision caps and MiMo. I found no changed lines in them. The new row describes a range of the demanded latest checkpoint ending just below the prompt end when it saves at least the floor. This concerns the SSD prefix cache (T-041, TB-007). Only a documentation row is added. It does not claim to alter cache salt scoping, HMAC lookup tags, the 30-minute TTL, disk budget, or encryption. I saw no sign it widens the at-rest surface or the accepted SEC-035 TTFT oracle. The excerpt for the new row is truncated and I could not see the code in EngineV2Factory+DemandedCheckpoint.swift or prefix-cache.md#streamed-complete-checkpoints. If the underlying code change is in the same PR, the next pass should check that checkpoint donation under this floor still goes through the existing per-donation gate (adoption bound plus benefit floor in SSDPrefixCache.donate), keeps the salt-folded HMAC tags, and adds no prompt-derived on-disk metadata. Nothing in these units indicates a regression. No threat-model update is needed from the supplied evidence.
